aadhaar.name: SetuX Aadhaar Services (Online Updates & Offline Biometric Link)

mobile_linking.title: Aadhaar Mobile Link & Biometric Update (Offline Visit Required)
mobile_linking.offline_note: ⚠️ OFFLINE VISIT REQUIRED: UIDAI regulations mandate live fingerprint and iris biometric capture. Mobile linking cannot be done purely online without biometrics.
mobile_linking.flowchart: [Start: SetuX Portal] ➔ [Update Center] ➔ [Aadhaar Mobile Link] ➔ [Enter Details & Pay ₹50 Fee] ➔ [Book SetuX Kendra Appointment / Doorstep Slot] ➔ [Physical Biometric Scan] ➔ [Get Tracking ID]
mobile_linking.process:
1. Open SetuX Portal & click 'Update Center'.
2. Select 'Aadhaar Services' -> Click 'Mobile & Biometric Update'.
3. Enter your Aadhaar number & new mobile number.
4. Pay SetuX service fee (₹50).
5. Book an appointment slot at the nearest SetuX Kendra OR request SetuX Doorstep Assistance.
6. Visit Kendra at scheduled time for biometric fingerprint/iris scan.
7. Receive OTP confirmation & track status live on SetuX.
required_documents: Original Aadhaar Card (No extra proof document required for mobile link)

address_update.title: Aadhaar Address Update (100% Online)
address_update.offline_note: ✅ 100% ONLINE PROCESS: No offline visit required. Processed completely via online document upload.
address_update.flowchart: [Start: SetuX Portal] ➔ [Update Center] ➔ [Aadhaar Services] ➔ [Address Update] ➔ [Upload Address Proof] ➔ [Pay ₹50 Fee] ➔ [Get SetuX Tracking ID]
address_update.process:
1. Open SetuX Portal & go to 'Update Center'.
2. Select 'Aadhaar Services' -> Click 'Address Update'.
3. Enter Aadhaar number & new address.
4. Upload valid Proof of Address (Electricity bill, Bank passbook with photo, Rent agreement, Passport, or Voter ID).
5. Pay SetuX service fee (₹50).
6. Submit & receive your SetuX Tracking ID.

name_dob_correction.title: Aadhaar Name & DOB Correction (100% Online)
name_dob_correction.offline_note: ✅ 100% ONLINE PROCESS: Processed fully online via document upload.
name_dob_correction.flowchart: [Start: SetuX Portal] ➔ [Update Center] ➔ [Aadhaar Services] ➔ [Name/DOB Correction] ➔ [Upload ID/Birth Proof] ➔ [Pay ₹50 Fee] ➔ [Get SetuX Tracking ID]
name_dob_correction.process:
1. Go to SetuX Portal -> 'Update Center'.
2. Choose 'Aadhaar Services' -> 'Name / DOB Correction'.
3. Fill in updated Name or Date of Birth.
4. Upload proof document (PAN Card, Birth Certificate - mandatory for DOB, 10th Marksheet, or Passport).
5. Pay SetuX fee (₹50).
6. Save SetuX Tracking ID.

child_biometric.title: Aadhaar Mandatory Child Biometric Update (Age 5 & 15)
child_biometric.offline_note: ⚠️ OFFLINE VISIT REQUIRED: Biometrics for children reaching age 5 or 15 require a physical biometric capture visit.
child_biometric.flowchart: [Start: SetuX Portal] ➔ [Update Center] ➔ [Child Biometric Update] ➔ [Enter Child Aadhaar] ➔ [Book SetuX Kendra Appointment] ➔ [Biometric Scan] ➔ [Get Tracking ID]
child_biometric.process:
1. Open SetuX Portal -> 'Update Center' -> 'Child Biometric Update'.
2. Enter Child Aadhaar Number and Parent Aadhaar.
3. Book a free appointment at the nearest SetuX Kendra.
4. Visit Kendra for fingerprint and photograph capture.
5. Receive SetuX Confirmation ID.

pan.name: SetuX PAN Card Services (New Apply, e-KYC & Correction)

new_pan.title: Apply for New PAN Card (100% Online e-KYC)
new_pan.offline_note: ✅ 100% ONLINE PROCESS: Processed online via e-KYC Aadhaar OTP.
new_pan.flowchart: [Start: SetuX Portal] ➔ [Apply New ID] ➔ [PAN Services] ➔ [New PAN Application (Form 49A)] ➔ [Upload Aadhaar & Photo] ➔ [Pay ₹106 Fee] ➔ [Get e-PAN & Physical Card]
new_pan.process:
1. Go to SetuX Portal -> Click 'Apply New ID'.
2. Select 'PAN Services' -> Choose 'New PAN Card Application (Form 49A)'.
3. Fill applicant details (Name, DOB, Father's Name, Address).
4. Upload Aadhaar Card, Passport Photo, and Signature scan.
5. Pay SetuX fee (₹106 for Physical Card + e-PAN).
6. Track dispatch & download e-PAN directly on SetuX.

pan_correction.title: PAN Card Data Correction (100% Online)

2. Choose 'PAN Services' -> 'PAN Data Correction'.

driving_license.name: SetuX Driving License Services (Online Address Update & Offline Test)

new_dl.title: Apply for New Driving License (Offline Test Visit Required)
new_dl.offline_note: ⚠️ OFFLINE VISIT REQUIRED: Parivahan motor vehicle rules strictly mandate attending a physical driving test at the RTO / SetuX Authorized Testing Track.
new_dl.flowchart: [Start: SetuX Portal] ➔ [Apply New ID] ➔ [Driving License Services] ➔ [New DL Application] ➔ [Upload Aadhaar & Photo] ➔ [Pay ₹250 Fee] ➔ [Schedule RTO Driving Test Slot] ➔ [Attend Test Visit] ➔ [Get DL Card]
new_dl.process:
1. Open SetuX Portal -> Click 'Apply New ID'.
2. Select 'Driving License Services' -> Click 'New DL / Learner Application'.
3. Fill applicant details (Name, DOB, Address, Blood Group).
4. Upload Aadhaar Card, Age Proof (10th Marksheet/Birth Cert), and Passport Photo.
5. Pay SetuX service fee (₹250).
6. Select preferred appointment date for physical driving test at RTO / Testing Track.
7. Attend physical driving test on appointment date & track DL card dispatch on SetuX.

address_change_dl.title: Driving License Address Change (100% Online)
address_change_dl.offline_note: ✅ 100% ONLINE PROCESS: Address update in DL is processed completely online via document upload.
address_change_dl.flowchart: [Start: SetuX Portal] ➔ [Update Center] ➔ [Driving License Services] ➔ [DL Address Change] ➔ [Upload Address Proof] ➔ [Pay ₹250 Fee] ➔ [Get SetuX Tracking ID]
address_change_dl.process:
1. Open SetuX Portal & click 'Update Center'.
2. Select 'Driving License Services' -> Choose 'Change of Address in DL'.
3. Enter your DL Number & Date of Birth.
4. Upload new Address Proof (Aadhaar Card or Passport).
5. Pay SetuX service fee (₹250).
6. Submit application & save SetuX Tracking ID.

passport.name: SetuX Passport Assistance Services (Offline PSK Verification Required)

new_passport.title: Apply for New Passport Assistance (Offline PSK Verification Required)
new_passport.offline_note: ⚠️ OFFLINE VISIT REQUIRED: Passport Act mandates a physical visit to the Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) for original document inspection and biometric capture.
new_passport.flowchart: [Start: SetuX Portal] ➔ [Apply New ID] ➔ [Passport Services] ➔ [New Application (Normal/Tatkal)] ➔ [Upload Aadhaar & Proofs] ➔ [Pay ₹350 Fee] ➔ [Select PSK Appointment Slot] ➔ [Physical Document Inspection Visit at PSK] ➔ [Passport Dispatched]
new_passport.process:
1. Go to SetuX Portal -> Click 'Apply New ID'.
2. Select 'Passport Services' -> Choose 'New Passport Application (Normal/Tatkal)'.
3. Fill in applicant details, family history, and current address.
4. Upload Aadhaar Card, DOB proof, and Address proof.
5. Pay SetuX service & appointment assistance fee (₹350).
6. Select your preferred appointment slot for physical verification at Passport Seva Kendra (PSK).
7. Visit PSK with original documents on appointment date & track dispatch live on SetuX.
required_documents: Original Bank Passbook / Utility Bill for Address Proof

voter_id.name: SetuX Voter ID Services (100% Online EPIC)

new_voter.title: Apply for New Voter ID (100% Online Form 6)
new_voter.flowchart: [Start: SetuX Portal] ➔ [Apply New ID] ➔ [Voter ID Services] ➔ [New Registration (Form 6)] ➔ [Upload Age & Address Proof] ➔ [Pay ₹25 Fee] ➔ [Get EPIC Card]
new_voter.process:
1. Open SetuX Portal -> Go to 'Apply New ID'.
2. Select 'Voter ID Services' -> Click 'New Voter Registration (Form 6)'.
3. Fill personal details, assembly constituency, and address.
4. Upload Age Proof (Aadhaar/10th Marksheet), Address Proof, and Photo.
5. Pay SetuX fee (₹25).
6. Receive SetuX Application Reference ID for EPIC tracking.

ration_card.name: SetuX Ration Card & Ayushman Services (100% Online)

add_member.title: Add Family Member to Ration Card (100% Online)

ayushman_card.title: Apply for Ayushman Bharat Health Card (100% Online)
ayushman_card.offline_note: ✅ 100% ONLINE PROCESS: Processed online via Ration Card / Aadhaar e-KYC.
ayushman_card.flowchart: [Start: SetuX Portal] ➔ [Apply New ID] ➔ [Ayushman Health Card] ➔ [Upload Ration Card & Aadhaar] ➔ [Pay ₹30 Fee] ➔ [Download Golden Card]
ayushman_card.process:
1. SetuX Portal -> 'Apply New ID' -> 'Ayushman Health Card'.
2. Enter Ration Card / Aadhaar Number.
3. Verify e-KYC via OTP.
4. Pay SetuX processing fee (₹30).
5. Download instant Ayushman Golden Card (₹5 Lakh free health cover).
